Local calibration and streamed prediction¶

This 2.0.0 offline example composes spatial-temporal out-of-fold beta calibration with AdaSTEM. It uses a small synthetic fixture, two ensembles and two workers, and compares native streaming/matrix and memmap predictions. Install the monitoring extra for notebook 10 and the tuning extra to construct the optional XGBoost recipe shown here.

The figures and metrics below are newly executed API demonstrations. They do not establish a best calibration method or validate copula inference. The older examples are retained separately; see the execution-status overview.

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
X = pd.DataFrame({"longitude": rng.uniform(-100, -70, 2500),
    "latitude": rng.uniform(25, 50, 2500), "DOY": rng.integers(121, 201, 2500),
    "environment": rng.normal(size=2500)})
truth = expit(-2.5 + X.environment + .8*np.sin((X.DOY-121)/80*np.pi))
y = pd.Series(rng.binomial(1, truth), index=X.index, name="occ")
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = ST_train_test_split(X, y.to_frame(),
    Spatio_blocks_count=10, Temporal_blocks_count=5, test_size=.25, random_state=42)
print(f"Training rows/events: {len(X_train)}/{int(y_train.occ.sum())}")
print(f"Held-out rows/events: {len(X_test)}/{int(y_test.occ.sum())}")

Held-out rows/events: 604/103

Each stixel receives three retained fold models and one identity-regularized beta map. Longitude/latitude metadata are supplied automatically to the CV wrapper and excluded from forest predictors; DOY remains a predictor. The generic wrapper can also be fitted directly outside AdaSTEM. Set sample_weights_for_classifier=False for this unweighted strategy.

In [3]:
Copied! 
base = CrossValidatedCalibratedClassifier(
    RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=15, max_depth=5, min_samples_leaf=10,
        n_jobs=1, random_state=42),
    BetaCalibrator(ridge=100), SpatioTemporalKFold(
        n_splits=3, Spatio_blocks_count=5, Temporal_blocks_count=5))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="stemflow_example_") as scratch:
    model = AdaSTEMClassifier(base_model=base, ensemble_fold=2,
        min_ensemble_required=1, points_lower_threshold=200,
        grid_len_upper_threshold=25, grid_len_lower_threshold=5,
        temporal_start=121, temporal_end=201, temporal_step=40,
        temporal_bin_interval=40, temporal_bin_start_jitter=0,
        sample_weights_for_classifier=False, ensemble_bootstrap=True,
        lazy_loading=True, lazy_loading_dir=str(Path(scratch)/"models"),
        n_jobs=2, random_state=42, save_gridding_plot=False, verbosity=0)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    with training_databases(X_train, y_train, directory=scratch) as (xp, yp):
        model.fit(xp, yp, temporal_window_prequery=True,
            training_data_backend="memmap", inner_max_num_threads=1, persist_prediction_state=False)
    fit_seconds = time.perf_counter()-started
    started = time.perf_counter()
    probability, std = model.predict_proba(X_test, return_std=True,
        temporal_window_prequery=True)
    prediction_seconds = time.perf_counter()-started
    execution = model.prediction_execution_info_.copy()
    mapped, mapped_std = model.predict_proba(X_test, return_std=True, n_jobs=2,
        temporal_window_prequery=True, prediction_backend="memmap")
    np.testing.assert_allclose(probability, mapped, atol=1e-12, equal_nan=True)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(std, mapped_std, atol=1e-12, equal_nan=True)
    matrix, matrix_std = model.predict_proba(X_test, return_std=True,
        temporal_window_prequery=True, streaming=False)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(probability, matrix, atol=1e-12, equal_nan=True)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(std, matrix_std, atol=1e-12, equal_nan=True)
    diagnostics = model.calibration_diagnostics(X_test, y_test, probability[:, 1])
    plots = Path(scratch)/"plots"
    plot_calibration_diagnostics(diagnostics, plots, max_curves=100)
    display(Image(filename=str(plots/"calibration_diagnostics.png")))
    display(Image(filename=str(plots/"stixel_calibration_overlay.png")))
    del model
print(f"Measured fit: {fit_seconds:.3f}s; streamed prediction: {prediction_seconds:.3f}s")
print(execution)
print("Native streaming/matrix and memmap predictions agree; temporary files removed.")

The red overlay averages actual common probability intervals, including observed zeros before plotting. Zero observations break logarithmic lines. Training-supported stixels use training counts, not held-out labels. Sparse bins and overlapping stixels limit interpretation of relative ECE; support counts, expected detections, loss and coverage should accompany it. The regression wrapper calibrates point means only. Detailed profiling is opt-in through STEMFLOW_PROFILE_DIR, STEMFLOW_PROFILE_LINES and STEMFLOW_PROFILE_ALLOCATIONS; run those profiles separately from timing comparisons. See local calibration and tuning and parallel execution.

Use the XGBoost recipe instead¶

The fitted example above uses a fixed small forest with blocked calibration. The following constructs the XGBoost alternative without launching another fit. Set tuning=True to add nested search; trial/fold/tree counts are independent controls. A generic tuner with another estimator/search space can be wrapped in the same calibration class. These settings illustrate the API, not a universally optimal ridge or search configuration.

In [5]:
Copied! 
recipe = local_beta_xgboost(
    tuning=False, ridge=100, n_trials=4,
    n_estimators=20, tuning_n_estimators=8,
    n_splits=3, tuning_n_splits=2,
    Spatio_blocks_count=5, Temporal_blocks_count=5,
    max_trials=10, tuning_verbose=False,
)
print(type(recipe).__name__)
print("Calibration folds:", recipe.cv.n_splits)
print("Spatial/temporal block counts:", recipe.cv.Spatio_blocks_count, recipe.cv.Temporal_blocks_count)
print("Ridge:", recipe.calibrator.ridge)
recipe = local_beta_xgboost( tuning=False, ridge=100, n_trials=4, n_estimators=20, tuning_n_estimators=8, n_splits=3, tuning_n_splits=2, Spatio_blocks_count=5, Temporal_blocks_count=5, max_trials=10, tuning_verbose=False, ) print(type(recipe).__name__) print("Calibration folds:", recipe.cv.n_splits) print("Spatial/temporal block counts:", recipe.cv.Spatio_blocks_count, recipe.cv.Temporal_blocks_count) print("Ridge:", recipe.calibrator.ridge)
